title: When the Asset Breaks Revisited
author: Kestrel Quintana
blurb: Vesper Amberdale, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
